properties.name: Ōkawasō
properties.name_ja: 大川荘 (会津芦ノ牧温泉)
properties.access: ~25 min S of Aizu-Wakamatsu; ~2 min from Ashinomaki-Onsen Stn. Business line +81 242-92-2111
properties.booking: Call ahead to confirm Feb 2 day-use hours + tattoo policy
properties.notes: Multi-storey wooden atrium — real-life Demon Slayer "Infinity Castle." Terraced valley-view rotenburo; shamisen in the lobby ~2 hr.

properties.name: Tsuruga Castle (Tsurugajō)
properties.access: In Aizu-Wakamatsu, short hop off the Ban-etsu line
properties.notes: Japan's only red-tiled keep, striking under snow. Samurai-anime backdrop (Touken Ranbu, Hakuōki). Pairs with Sazaedō + katsudon lunch.

properties.name: Ashinomaki-Onsen Station cat stationmaster
properties.access: ~2 min from Ōkawasō
properties.notes: Aizu Railway station with a feline "stationmaster." Quirky free ~10-min stop, clusters with Ōkawasō.

properties.name: animate Aomori
properties.access: 古川1-14-5, フクシスポーツビル 4F, ~6 min walk from Aomori Stn east exit
properties.notes: Aomori-city anime/manga/goods flagship, in the 古川 block with the nokke-don + miso-curry-milk cluster. Hours [weekday]12:00–18:00 / [Sat/Sun/hol]11:00–18:00. Flying Witch is set in Hirosaki (seichō tie-in). [AOMORI]

properties.name: Aomori Bay illumination (Aspam / A-Factory front)
properties.name_ja: 青森ベイエリア イルミネーション（アスパム前）
properties.access: Aomori Bay waterfront, Aspam 安方1-1-40, 1 min from Aomori Stn
properties.notes: Evening bay-side lights around the Aspam triangle tower + A-Factory / bay bridge — easy after-dinner stroll. Area pin anchored on Aspam. [AOMORI]

properties.name: Nokke-don (Furukawa Market)
properties.name_ja: のっけ丼（青森魚菜センター／古川市場）
properties.access: Central Aomori, 5–6 min walk from Aomori Stn (古川1-11-16)
properties.booking: Walk-in — great for 7, everyone builds their own
properties.dates: Nokke-don 7:00–16:00; market closed Tuesdays (Feb 6 Sat open)
properties.notes: Build-your-own kaisendon — buy meal tickets, swap for rice, top it stall by stall. Lunch-oriented; arrive early or use as a Feb 6 breakfast. [AOMORI] arrival stop.

properties.name: A-FACTORY
properties.access: Aomori Bay, beside JR Aomori Stn (柳川1-4-2)
properties.notes: Glass-walled waterfront cidery — tasting machines for Aomori hard cider + food hall & apple sweets. Clusters with Nebuta WA·RASSE + Hakkōda-maru. [AOMORI]

properties.name: Aji no Sapporo Ōnishi (miso curry milk ramen)
properties.access: Central Aomori (古川), walk from Aomori Stn
properties.notes: Aomori's cult bowl — miso + curry powder + milk + butter, invented at "Aji no Sapporo" (est. 1968). Ōnishi is the best-known flagship; ~5 shops citywide serve it. Pin is Ōnishi, not the 新町 分店. [AOMORI]

properties.name: Nagao Chūka Soba (Aomori niboshi ramen)
properties.access: Aomori city — pin is the 青森駅前店 branch, ~200 m / 3 min from Aomori Stn
properties.notes: Aomori's everyday signature — heavy sardine-broth (niboshi) shoyu. Counterpoint to the miso-curry-milk novelty. Four branches in the city; this pin is 青森駅前店 (the central one). Others: 西バイパス本店, 中央店, 東バイパス店. [AOMORI]

properties.name: Asamushi Aquarium
properties.access: 青森市浅虫字馬場山1-25, on the bay ~20 min E of Aomori
properties.notes: Coastal aquarium with dolphin shows — natural last stop before Aomori; clusters with the Asamushi ryokan option (Nanbuya Kaisenkaku). [AOMORI].

properties.name: Nebuta Museum WA RASSE
properties.name_ja: ねぶたの家 ワ・ラッセ
properties.access: 青森市安方1-1-1, 1 min from JR Aomori Stn
properties.notes: Giant illuminated Nebuta festival floats indoors year-round + taiko/haneto demos. Open into the evening — best Aomori-city arrival-night hit. [AOMORI].

properties.name: Hakkōda Ropeway (snow monsters)
properties.name_ja: 八甲田ロープウェー（樹氷）
properties.cost: Ropeway round-trip ~¥2,000 (confirm); guided snowshoe tours extra
properties.access: 山麓駅, 荒川寒水沢1-12; ~1 hr S of central Aomori by van
properties.booking: Walk-in for the ropeway; reserve snowshoe tours
properties.dates: Peak white juhyō Feb–Mar
properties.notes: Aomori-todomatsu firs frozen into "snow monsters"; 15-min cable car to 1,324 m. Sightseeing, NOT skiing. Jan–Feb crowds — waits up to ~150 min; runs every 20 min; suspends in bad weather (verify morning-of). Clusters with Sukayu on Rte 103. Pin = 山麓 (base) station; the 山頂公園 summit station is 2.4 km SE. [AOMORI]

properties.name: Aomori Museum of Art
properties.access: 安田字近野185, next to Sannai-Maruyama; ~15 min by van
properties.dates: Confirm winter Monday closures
properties.notes: Home of Nara Yoshitomo's work + the giant outdoor "Aomori-ken" dog. Clusters with the Sannai-Maruyama Jōmon site. [AOMORI]

properties.name: Hasshoku Center (Shichirin-mura)
properties.name_ja: 八食センター 七厘村
properties.cost: ¥400pp for a 2-hr grill seat + whatever you buy
properties.access: Near JR Hachinohe Stn (河原木字神才22-2); ¥100/¥200 loop buses or park the van
properties.booking: Walk-in, great for 7. Market + Shichirin-mura closed Weds (Feb 5 Fri = open)
properties.notes: Buy seafood/meat at ~70 stalls, grill it yourself over charcoal. East-line group-food highlight on the Feb 5 Hachinohe day. [EAST]

properties.name: Miroku Yokochō
properties.name_ja: 八戸屋台村 みろく横丁
properties.access: Central Hachinohe (三日町〜六日町)
properties.booking: Stalls tiny (~8 seats each) — spread across a few or reserve a larger izakaya
properties.notes: 26-stall yatai alley; Hachinohe senbei-jiru, seafood, oden, skewers, Hachinohe ramen. Good Feb 5 lunch/dinner. [EAST]

properties.name: Hachinohe Shuzō (Mutsu Hassen)
properties.access: 八戸市湊町; confirm winter tour hours
properties.booking: Shop walk-in; call ahead for a tour for 7
properties.notes: Well-regarded brewery in the old port district — tasting + Mutsu Hassen bottles. [EAST]. COORD APPROXIMATE: the brewery is absent from OSM, so this pin is the GSI district point for 大字湊町 — the actual kura is somewhere in that district; confirm the street address before navigating.

properties.name: Goryōkaku Tower (Detective Conan seichō)
properties.access: 五稜郭町43-9; ~15 min from Hakodate Stn. Winter ~9:00–18:00
properties.notes: Setting of the 2024 film "名探偵コナン 100万ドルの五稜星"; viewpoint over the star fort. Hakodate is also Love Live! Sunshine!! / Hakuōki territory. Pin is the tower itself, 346 m SW of the fort centroid.

properties.name: animate Hakodate
properties.access: 美原1-4-3 3F (near Goryōkaku); 11:00–19:00
properties.notes: Southern Hokkaidō anime/manga flagship.

properties.name: Hakodate Illumination (Winter Festival)
properties.name_ja: はこだてイルミネーション
properties.access: Hachiman-zaka / 開港通り, Motomachi
properties.dates: ~late Nov – Mar 31, sunset–22:00 (2025–26 dates; confirm 2026–27)
properties.notes: Winter-festival centrepiece, nightly. Feb 7 Sun fine. Pin is 八幡坂 itself, offset 113 m from the Motomachi churches pin.

properties.name: Goryōkaku Hoshi no Yume star illumination
properties.cost: Free to walk the moat; tower entry extra
properties.access: Goryōkaku (五稜郭町)
properties.dates: ~Dec 1 – Feb 28, lit sunset–19:00 daily (confirm 2026–27)
properties.notes: Moat outlined in ~2,000 bulbs into a glowing star; best from the tower. Pin is the 五稜郭公園 node, clustering with the fort and tower pins at Goryōkaku by design.

properties.name: Hakodate Asaichi
properties.access: ~2 min W of Hakodate Stn
properties.notes: ~250-stall morning market; winter yari-ika squid, catch-your-own live squid, kaisendon (Kikuyo Shokudō tomoe-don is the icon). Good Feb-8 breakfast before the Tōya drive. Area pin on 函館朝市ひろば, 186 m from the station.

properties.name: Lucky Pierrot (Bay Area)
properties.name_ja: ラッキーピエロ ベイエリア本店
properties.access: Bay Area flagship, 末広町; branches citywide
properties.notes: Hakodate-area-only burger chain (17 branches); Chinese Chicken Burger. A Love Live! Sunshine!! spot. Wed = ramen 30% off. Pin is the 末広町18 ベイエリア本店, not one of the other branches.

properties.name: Ajisai (Hakodate shio ramen)
properties.name_ja: 麺厨房 あじさい 本店
properties.access: 本店 by Goryōkaku (五稜郭町29-22); also station/bay branches
properties.notes: One of Hokkaidō's big-3 ramen — clear pork-bone shio. Pin is the 五稜郭 本店.

properties.name: Hasegawa Store (Bay Area)
properties.name_ja: ハセガワストア ベイエリア店
properties.access: Bay Area branch, 末広町
properties.notes: Pork-skewer yakitori bento, GLAY/local icon; classic combo w/ a Lucky Pierrot burger on a Goryōkaku bench. Sits 19 m from the Lucky Pierrot Bay Area flagship — grab both in one stop.

properties.name: Daimon Yokochō
properties.access: 松風町7-5, ~5 min from Hakodate Stn
properties.booking: Reserve a bigger stall ahead for 7
properties.notes: Yatai izakaya village near the station — the group night out. Area pin on the yokochō (函館ひかりの屋台 大門横丁), not one venue.

properties.name: Marukatsu Suisan (kaiten-zushi)
properties.name_ja: 函館まるかつ水産 本店
properties.access: Bay Area (豊川町), near Kanemori
properties.notes: Fresh-seafood kaiten-zushi, group-friendly. Pin is the 豊川町 本店.

properties.name: Hakodate Beer
properties.access: 大手町5-22, bayfront
properties.notes: Bayfront brewpub for a group beer-and-food night; Genghis Khan/izakaya plates. Absent from OSM — pin is the GSI address point for 大手町5番22号.

properties.name: Goryōken
properties.access: 末広町4-5 (Motomachi)
properties.notes: 1879 Western yōshoku house famous for English-style curry — a Hakodate oddity, roomy for 7.

properties.name: Snaffle's (cheese omelette)
properties.access: Station + Kanemori branches
properties.notes: The jiggly cheese-omelette cake — Hakodate souvenir sweet. COORD APPROXIMATE: no Hakodate branch is in OSM and no street address was supplied (the only OSM "スナッフルス" is a Sapporo shop, 250 km away), so this pin is JR Hakodate Stn itself — confirm the exact shop unit on the day.

properties.name: Hakodate Jiyū Ichiba
properties.access: 新川町1-2, ~10 min from the station
properties.notes: More local/less touristy market — cheap standing-bar seafood if Asaichi prices grate.

properties.name: Round1 Stadium Hakodate
properties.name_ja: ラウンドワンスタジアム 函館店
properties.access: ~10 min from Hokuto-Oiwake IC — out of town, use van
properties.booking: Walk-in; phone ahead for bowling lanes
properties.notes: Southern Hokkaido's largest — 38 lanes, karaoke, Spo-Cha with go-karts/mini-bikes. Open 10:00–0:00 (24 hr Fri/Sat/holiday-eve). Fits Feb 7–8. Coords from GSI for the official lot 西桔梗町848-11; not present in OpenStreetMap.

properties.name: Mt Hakodate Ropeway (night view)
properties.cost: ¥1,500 round trip adult (¥1,000 one-way); group rate
properties.access: Sanroku stn 元町19-7 (tram to Jūjigai). Winter 10:00–21:00, last up 20:50
properties.notes: Michelin 3-star night view; cold winter air = clearest. Summit road closed in winter so ropeway is the only way up. Pin is the 山麓 (base) station; 山頂駅 is 791 m WSW.

properties.name: Goryōkaku (star fort)
properties.access: 五稜郭町
properties.notes: Star-shaped Edo fort under snow; walk the moat. Pin is the fort centroid, distinct from the tower pin 346 m SW.

properties.name: Hakodate Tropical Botanical Garden (monkeys in onsen)
properties.access: 湯川町3-1-15. Winter 9:30–16:30, closed Dec 29–Jan 1
properties.notes: Japanese macaques soaking in a hot spring (Dec–early May), 50-year tradition, by the Yunokawa ryokan. Daytime only.

properties.name: Motomachi slopes & churches
properties.name_ja: 元町 教会群・八幡坂
properties.access: Motomachi; tram to Suehirochō/Jūjigai
properties.notes: "Exotic hillside" — Hachiman-zaka, Orthodox/Catholic/Anglican churches, Old Public Hall. Pin is 函館ハリストス正教会 (元町13), 113 m from the Hachiman-zaka illumination pin.

properties.name: Kanemori Red Brick Warehouses
properties.access: 末広町14, bayfront
properties.notes: Bayfront brick warehouses of shops/food halls; winter "floating shrine" event at the adjacent Kanemori shrine.

properties.name: Yunokawa Onsen footbath
properties.name_ja: 湯の川温泉 湯巡り舞台
properties.access: By the 湯の川温泉 tram stop
properties.notes: Free riverside footbath + wa-style illumination stroll, steps from the ryokan.

properties.name: Cape Tachimachi
properties.access: 住吉町; tram to the end + short walk
properties.notes: Snowy cliff-cape view reached via Hakodate's vintage streetcars. Confirm the cape road isn't snow-closed on the day.

properties.name: Marukan Building Grand Cafeteria (chopstick soft-serve)
properties.access: ~15 min walk from Hanamaki Stn, just off Route 4; 6F 上町6-2
properties.dates: Reportedly closed Wednesdays — confirm; ~11:00–18:30
properties.notes: Showa-retro cafeteria; 25 cm 10-tier soft serve eaten with chopsticks. Also a Miyazawa Kenji / Shohei Ohtani spot.

properties.name: Chūson-ji (Konjikidō golden hall)
properties.access: ~5 min from Hiraizumi-Maesawa IC; hillside temple
properties.dates: Winter hrs ~8:30–16:30
properties.notes: UNESCO World Heritage; gold-leaf golden hall under snow. Clusters with Mōtsū-ji + Takkoku no Iwaya.

properties.name: Mōtsū-ji
properties.access: ~7 min walk from Hiraizumi Stn; clusters with Chūson-ji
properties.notes: Heian-era Pure Land pond-garden — beautiful and near-empty snowed-in in Feb.

properties.name: Hirosaki Castle Snow Lantern Festival
properties.access: Hirosaki Park (下白銀町1); ~45–50 min W of Aomori by van, or bus ~15 min from Hirosaki Stn
properties.dates: Early–mid Feb; 2025 & 2026 both Feb 6–11; 2027 not posted — confirm. Feb 6 Sat likely opening
properties.notes: One of the Michinoku Five Great Snow Festivals — ~150 snow lanterns + ~300 candle-lit mini-kamakura ringing the pond below the keep, lit at dusk; big snow sculpture + slides. Flying Witch seichō town. Pin = the castle keep inside Hirosaki Park; the festival spreads across the park.

properties.name: Hirosaki Electrical Fantasy (winter illumination)
properties.name_ja: 弘前エレクトリカルファンタジー
properties.access: Hirosaki Park / Otemon (追手門) area
properties.dates: ~Dec – late Feb; reliably on regardless of Snow Lantern dates
properties.notes: Winter light-up of Hirosaki Park's Western-style heritage buildings + street trees. Runs alongside the Snow Lantern Festival window. Pin = Otemon, the park's south main gate, 457 m S of the castle keep.

properties.name: Trappist Monastery
properties.access: 北斗市三ツ石, near Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto
properties.notes: Poplar-lined approach + snowy grounds; famous butter cookies + soft-serve at the gate shop (直売店 ~250 m SE of this pin). Van #2.

properties.name: Sekinoichi Shuzō (brewery + restaurant)
properties.cost: Tasting modest; on-site mochi-zen set under ~¥2,000
properties.access: ~10 min from Ichinoseki Stn, 田村町5-42
properties.notes: Working sake brewery with tour + tasting; the on-site Kuramoto Restaurant Sekinoichi serves ~20 seasonal Ichinoseki mochi dishes. Group food+drink hit.

properties.name: Karaage Benten-ya (Ichinoseki karaage)
properties.access: Near Ichinoseki City Hall (一関市役所); small takeout with parking
properties.notes: Cheap made-to-order karaage — good shareable roadside grab. Alt: Oyama's 奥州いわいどりからあげ家 at 狐禅寺 for Murone-style karaage. Pinned to 寿町12-4 (~390 m from the city hall); listing sites disagree, also showing 大手町 and 山目 — worth confirming by phone.

properties.name: Geibikei Gorge kotatsu boat (winter)
properties.name_ja: 猊鼻渓 舟下り（こたつ舟）
properties.access: ~25 min by car from Ichinoseki IC; 5-min walk from Geibikei Stn. Geibi Tourist Center, 長坂字町467 Higashiyama
properties.booking: Boat = walk-in; reserve the 7-top kinagashi-nabe hotpot ahead
properties.dates: Kotatsu boats Dec 1–late Feb, winter departures ~9:30–15:00
properties.notes: Flat-bottom punt through 100m cliffs; heated covered kotatsu boats in winter. Suspends in bad weather — confirm the day. Feb 4 Sendai→Morioka leg. Pinned to the boat landing (舟着場); the tourist-centre address given sits ~330 m away.

properties.name: Genbikei Gorge "flying dango" (Kakkō Dango)
properties.name_ja: 厳美渓 郭公だんご
properties.access: ~10 min from Ichinoseki IC, roadside at Genbikei gorge
properties.dates: CLOSED IN WINTER — Ichinoseki's official tourism site lists 冬季休業 12月〜3月上旬
properties.notes: Order dango via a basket that ziplines across the river. Quirky/cheap. NOT the same gorge as the Geibikei boat ride. WARNING: this is a seasonal closure, not a weather call — the shop is shut Dec through early March, so it will not be open during the trip. Gorge itself is still walkable. Verify against their Instagram before writing it into a day plan.

properties.name: Sahara Glass Park
properties.access: Near Genbikei, ~10 min from Ichinoseki IC, 厳美町字滝ノ上380-1
properties.notes: Hands-on glassblowing/beadwork + shop and footbath. Good group activity near Genbikei — ~110 m from the flying-dango stand, so they pair naturally.

properties.name: Lake Inawashiro swans
properties.access: Roadside on the Ban-etsu corridor
properties.notes: Migratory whooper swans wintering against Mt. Bandai — 20-min photo stop basically on the expressway. Sora no Manimani model location. Pinned to Shidahama (志田浜), the usual viewing beach, not the lake centroid.

properties.name: Bannai Shokudō (Kitakata ramen)
properties.access: ~20 min N of Aizu-Wakamatsu, off the Ban-etsu line
properties.notes: One of Japan's big-3 ramen towns; light shoyu, thick flat noodles, morning-ramen culture. Chāshū-piled niku-soba icon. Feb 2 drive stop.

properties.name: Sugō Shokudō (Kuroishi tsuyu-yakisoba)
properties.access: 黒石市一番町186, ~5 min from Kuroishi Stn; near Kuroishi IC on the Aomori Expwy approach
properties.booking: Small (~18 seats), solo-run, irregular closures — call ahead or split
properties.notes: Fat yakisoba noodles served in hot soba broth — 1912 "hundred-year diner" by the Komise arcade.

properties.name: Kyōgoku Fukidashi Park
properties.access: 京極町, toward Niseko
properties.notes: Yōtei snowmelt spring, one of Japan's 100 famous waters, dramatic frozen; FLAG opposite direction from Noboribetsu (ski country) — Noboribetsu OR this, not both.

properties.name: Matsushima Oyster × Warm-Sake Festival
properties.name_ja: 松島 牡蠣×燗酒フェスティバル
properties.cost: Free entry; oyster dishes pay-per; sake ¥300/glass
properties.access: Matsushima Rikyū, 1 min from Matsushima-Kaigan Stn; ~30 min E of Sendai by van
properties.dates: 2026 ran from ~Feb 1 into March — confirm your-year dates
properties.notes: 10+ oyster dishes + ~20 Miyagi sakes at Matsushima Rikyū. Long run = reliably on your dates, unlike the one-day Kaki Matsuri (first Sun of Feb).

properties.name: Matsushima Bay
properties.access: ~30 min E of Sendai by van; JR Senseki Line to Matsushima-Kaigan
properties.booking: Cruise walk-in; kakigoya hut — book ahead for 7
properties.dates: Winter = peak oyster season
properties.notes: One of Japan's "three great views." Peak winter oyster season — kakigoya grill-your-own huts. Pairs with Shiogama sushi. Anchor near the Matsushima-Kaigan waterfront.

properties.name: animate Morioka
properties.access: 盛岡駅前通7-12, はちや盛岡駅前ビル 2F — ~5 min from Morioka Stn east exit
properties.notes: Iwate's anime/manga/game flagship — figures, trading cards, ani-kuji, character goods. Address confirmed Aug 2026 from animate's own store page; it is by the station on 駅前通, not in the Ōdōri/Saien area.

properties.name: Morioka Ōdōri arcade (used-goods & gachapon)
properties.access: Central Morioka, walkable
properties.notes: Covered downtown shopping street for a loose second-hand/otaku crawl (Book-Off-type shops, crane games). Loose anchor — a browsing district, not one shop. Anchored on 大通二丁目; ~700 m east of animate.

properties.name: Azumaya (wanko soba)
properties.access: Central Morioka, 中ノ橋通1-8-3
properties.notes: All-you-can-slurp wanko soba — big group event. One of Morioka's three great noodles.

properties.name: Pairon (jajamen)
properties.name_ja: じゃじゃ麺 白龍（パイロン）本店
properties.access: Central Morioka near Morioka Castle / Sakurayama, 内丸5-15
properties.notes: Originator of Morioka jajamen (flat noodles + meat-miso, chītantan egg-soup finish). Cheap, unique. One of the three great noodles.

properties.name: Pyonpyon-sha (Morioka reimen)
properties.access: Near Morioka Stn (GINGA branch is group-friendly)
properties.notes: Morioka cold reimen — chewy noodles, spicy-cool broth, kimchi. Group/station-friendly. Shokudōen (食道園) is the original inventor. One of the three great noodles. Pinned to the GINGA branch at 盛岡駅前通9-5.

properties.name: Fukuda Pan (koppepan)
properties.name_ja: 福田パン 長田町本店
properties.access: 長田町12-11, a bit N of Morioka Stn — by van
properties.notes: Build-your-own koppepan filled rolls, sweet + savoury. Beloved Morioka institution. Cheap, fast, quirky.

properties.name: Chokurian (wanko soba)
properties.access: Central Morioka near Nakano-bashi, walk/van from station
properties.booking: Wanko first-come, no phone res; split tables at 7
properties.notes: Older/calmer wanko soba alt to Azumaya, reputedly Morioka's first (est. 1884); ~9 condiments to vary bowls.

properties.name: Meat Yoneuchi (butcher + reimen)
properties.access: ~10 min N of station along Nakatsu River, at foot of Kami-no-hashi
properties.notes: 1899 butcher that also serves a locally loved reimen; order with the spicy option.

properties.name: Asabiraki Brewery
properties.access: 盛岡市大慈寺町, ~10 min van E of station
properties.booking: Shop walk-in; call ahead for a 7-person brewery tour; confirm winter hours
properties.notes: Morioka sake brewery (Nanbu Tōji heartland) with shop + tasting; anchor for the Iwate-sake stop.

properties.name: Konyacho Banya (retro cafe)
properties.access: Konya-chō, central Morioka, walkable with Red Brick Bldg + river
properties.notes: Cafe + crafts in an 1891 former fire station; near the old Gozaku (ござ九) merchant district. ~120 m from the Iwate Bank Red Brick Building, so they pair on one walk.

properties.name: Round1 Stadium Morioka
properties.name_ja: ラウンドワンスタジアム 盛岡店
properties.cost: TBC — Spocha free-play priced by time block
properties.access: ~5 min walk west of Morioka Station (盛岡駅西通)
properties.notes: Spocha, bowling, arcade, giga crane games. Listed as 24h, no closing days — reconfirm nearer the date. Good rainy/late-night fallback for a group of 7.

properties.name: Iwate Bank Red Brick Building
properties.cost: Iwate Bank zone free; Morioka Bank museum zone ~¥300
properties.access: 中ノ橋通1丁目, central Morioka, walkable
properties.notes: Meiji red-brick landmark by Kingo Tatsuno (Tokyo Station architect); only surviving Tatsuno design in Tōhoku; photogenic over the Nakatsu River/Nakano Bridge.

properties.name: Kaiunbashi & Nakatsu River walk
properties.access: Directly in front of Morioka Stn over the Kitakami River
properties.notes: Bridge framing Mt Iwate (locally teased "letdown" view); quick photo stop + short riverside walk to the Red Brick Building. Note the bridge itself spans the Kitakami; the Nakatsu is the smaller river downtown by the Red Brick Building, ~1.3 km east.

properties.name: Ishiwari-zakura
properties.access: 盛岡地方裁判所 (Morioka District Court), 内丸, central
properties.notes: Cherry tree growing out of a split granite boulder in the courthouse forecourt; an oddity even bare in winter.

properties.name: ZOOMO (Morioka Zoo)
properties.cost: ¥1,000 adult (high school+); ¥800pp for groups of 20+; ¥500 elementary/middle
properties.access: 新庄字下八木田, SE of the city, ~20 min van
properties.dates: Open through winter, 10:00–16:00 (last entry 15:30) Nov 1–Mar 31. CLOSED Wednesdays AND Thursdays in the winter season
properties.notes: Recently rebuilt city zoo, quiet in winter. Hours and price confirmed Aug 2026 from ZOOMO's own site: it does NOT close for the season, but the winter Wed+Thu closure is easy to trip over. Allow ~2 hrs to see everything.

properties.name: Naruko Onsen & Naruko Gorge
properties.access: ~1 hr N of Sendai by van; JR Rikuu-East Line to Naruko-Onsen
properties.notes: Characterful old onsen town + dramatic gorge (鳴子峡) + Naruko kokeshi. Quieter soak-and-eat half-day. Administratively Ōsaki City — reverse-geocode may show 大崎市. Anchor on Naruko-Onsen Station.

properties.name: Niigata City Manga & Anime Information Center
properties.name_ja: 新潟市マンガ・アニメ情報館
properties.access: Bandai City, near Niigata Stn
properties.notes: Permanent exhibits on Rumiko Takahashi & Fujio Akatsuka + rotating shows. NOT Gundam-focused.

properties.name: NIIGATA Pageant of Lights
properties.access: Station South Exit & Keyaki-dori, 5 min from station
properties.dates: Ends Jan 31 annually — arrival night only (confirm season dates)
properties.notes: ~200 trees, 160,000 bulbs. Lit 17:00–24:10. Area pin anchored on the station south exit.

properties.name: Ponshukan Niigata Station
properties.name_ja: ぽんしゅ館 新潟駅店
properties.cost: TBC — token-based sake tasting, buy tokens at the counter
properties.access: Inside CoCoLo Niigata, Niigata Station west connecting passage
properties.notes: Sake tasting wall with ~100 Niigata breweries, self-serve by token. NOTE: there is a second Ponshukan at Echigo-Yuzawa Station — this feature is the Niigata Station one.

properties.name: Pia Bandai / Minato Marché
properties.access: ~¥210 bus from Niigata Stn, near the port
properties.booking: Market walk-in; call ahead for big sit-down tables
properties.notes: Sea-of-Japan seafood market (winter = nodoguro, snow crab, buri). On-site restaurants + conveyor sushi. Good Feb 1 lunch or Feb 2 breakfast.

properties.name: Furumachi izakaya district
properties.access: Central Niigata, Furumachi
properties.notes: Old dining-and-geisha quarter, best seafood-and-sake spots. Core group food+drink evening (Feb 1). Area pin — pick a specific izakaya later. Anchored on the 古町 crossing at 柾谷小路, not a single venue.

properties.name: Tonkatsu Taro
properties.access: Furumachi
properties.booking: Walk-in; small & queue-prone — go early or split into 2 tables
properties.notes: Birthplace of tarekatsudon (thin cutlets in sweet soy-dashi tare). Niigata signature dish.

properties.name: Sankichiya
properties.access: Central Niigata
properties.notes: Classic light Niigata assari-shoyu ramen — one of the prefecture's 5 signature styles.

properties.name: Suzakaya
properties.cost: Evening set w/ sake, noppe & sashimi ~¥2,200
properties.access: 4 min from Niigata Stn
properties.notes: Hegi soba — funori-seaweed soba in bundles on a wooden tray. Divisive texture = fun group order. Pinned to the 新潟駅前店 branch (弁天1-4-29).

properties.name: Mikazuki
properties.access: Bandai
properties.notes: Niigata "Italian" — thick chow-mein noodles under tomato meat sauce. Weird, cheap, fast. Pinned to the 万代シテイ branch; it is a local chain.

properties.name: Sekitori
properties.access: Central Niigata
properties.notes: Hanmi-age — deep-fried half-chicken with curry powder + salt. Great beer food to share. Pinned to 本店 (横七番町通); there are also 古町, 女池 and 青山 branches.

properties.name: Inakaya
properties.access: Furumachi
properties.notes: Originating shop for wappa-meshi (rice steamed in a bent-cedar box with salmon/crab/roe).

properties.name: Round1 Stadium Niigata
properties.name_ja: ラウンドワンスタジアム 新潟店
properties.access: Rte 116 near the Shinano River; free shuttle from Niigata Stn south exit
properties.notes: Only R1 in the prefecture — Spo-Cha, bowling, karaoke, ~330 machines. Check Sun/Mon closing times. Fits Jan 31 / Feb 1.

properties.name: Nanbu Senbei no Sato
properties.name_ja: 南部せんべいの里（巖手屋／小松製菓）
properties.access: 二戸市, off the Tōhoku Expwy near Ninohe; confirm winter hours
properties.notes: Working senbei factory + shop — the cracker that goes into Hachinohe senbei-jiru. Factory viewing. [MAIN] on the Morioka→Aomori line. COORD APPROXIMATE: the site is absent from OSM and no street address was supplied, so this pin is the GSI municipal point for 二戸市 — get the exact address before navigating to it.

properties.name: Jigokudani Night Light-up (Onibi no Michi)
properties.name_ja: 鬼火の路（登別地獄谷ライトアップ）
properties.access: 登別地獄谷 boardwalk, after dark
properties.dates: Confirm winter operating nights
properties.notes: Jigokudani's steam + path lit after dark — "demon-fire path". Pin is the 三途の川 boardwalk section, 156 m from the Jigokudani viewpoint pin.

properties.name: Dai-ichi Takimotokan
properties.cost: ~¥2,250 day-use (confirm 2026 rate; evening discount promo ended Feb 2026)
properties.access: ~15 min by car from JR Noboribetsu Stn; ~10 min from Noboribetsu-Higashi IC
properties.booking: Walk-in, no reservation; check tattoo policy
properties.notes: 35 tubs, 5–7 spring types, drinking-spring station, hot-water pool + slide. "Department store of hot springs." Fits Feb 9 Noboribetsu day.

properties.name: Ōyunuma & Ōyunuma-gawa Natural Footbath
properties.name_ja: 大湯沼・大湯沼川天然足湯
properties.access: 登別温泉町, above Jigokudani (trail from 大湯沼 lot)
properties.notes: Cobalt-blue geothermal river footbath; FLAG deep snow Dec–Mar makes the trail dicey — do the Ōyunuma overlook only unless cleared. Pin is the footbath; 大湯沼 pond is 328 m E, the 展望台 overlook 340 m ESE.

properties.name: Jigokudani Hell Valley
properties.access: 登別温泉町, ~10 min from Noboribetsu-Higashi IC
properties.notes: 450 m blast crater venting sulphur steam; 600 m loop ~20 min + 30-min path to Ōyunuma overlook; white steam vs snow.

properties.name: Noboribetsu Date Jidaimura
properties.access: 登別市中登別町53-1, ~3 min Noboribetsu-Higashi IC; winter 9:00–16:00 (last entry 15:00), daily
properties.dates: Winter season Nov 1–early Mar
properties.notes: Edo culture park — ninja shows, oiran + winter samurai show, shuriken dojo, costume rental; the Noboribetsu anchor.

properties.name: Noboribetsu Bear Park
properties.access: 登別温泉町224, ropeway from onsen strip
properties.notes: Mountaintop bear park + Ainu Yukar village; pricier/longer than the Shōwa-shinzan ranch. Pin is the hilltop park (matches the 224 address); board the ropeway at the strip, 1.25 km W.

properties.name: Enma-dō & Gokuraku-dōri
properties.name_ja: 閻魔堂・極楽通り商店街
properties.access: 登別温泉町 main street
properties.notes: Animatronic King Enma "face-changing" show several times daily amid demon statues; eats + onsen-manjū along the strip.

properties.name: Noboribetsu Marine Park Nixe
properties.name_ja: 登別マリンパークニクス
properties.access: 登別市登別東町1-22, near JR Noboribetsu Stn; daily
properties.booking: Walk-in; buy online to skip queue
properties.notes: Danish-castle aquarium with a daily penguin parade; all-weather change of pace.

properties.name: Ginzan Onsen
properties.cost: Ashiyu free; day-use baths vary; evening day-tripper shuttle ~¥1,150
properties.access: ~2–2.5 hr N of Sendai by van — a stretch as a day trip
properties.booking: WINTER RESTRICTIONS (this season Dec 20–Mar 1): day cars park at Taishō Romankan + shuttle in; 5–8 pm slot capped 100/hr, reservation required; overnight-guests only after 8 pm
properties.dates: Winter access rules ~Dec 20 – Mar 1 — confirm your-year dates
properties.notes: Taishō-era gas-lamp onsen town, Spirited Away vibes in snow. Spectacular but far — better as an overnight than a day trip.

properties.name: Animate Sendai
properties.access: E-beans 7–8F, Sendai Stn west exit
properties.notes: Largest anime store in Tōhoku, animate Café inside. Sendai is Haikyuu!! country (author Haruichi Furudate is from Miyagi) — big Haikyuu wall.

properties.name: Otaku shop cluster — Gamers / Surugaya / Toranoana
properties.name_ja: ゲーマーズ / 駿河屋 / とらのあな
properties.access: Sendai Stn west-exit area (Clis Road / Chūō-dōri)
properties.notes: Walkable otaku circuit — Gamers, Surugaya (used figures/manga), Toranoana + Mandarake nearby. Area pin; anchor near Gamers Sendai, ~40 m from Animate.

properties.name: Pokémon Center Tōhoku
properties.name_ja: ポケモンセンタートウホク
properties.access: Short walk from Sendai Stn
properties.notes: Tōhoku's Pokémon flagship. Address confirmed Aug 2026: Sendai PARCO 3F, 中央1-2-3 (moved there 2017; renovated Mar 2025 to ~4x the floor area).

properties.name: SENDAI Bright Lights STORY
properties.access: Jōzenji-dōri, central Sendai (evenings)
properties.dates: 1st edition ran Jan 19 – Feb 28, 2026 — confirm your-year dates & official name
properties.notes: New 4-zone street illumination, companion to the December Pageant of Starlight. On the Feb 2–3 window. Anchor on Jōzenji-dōri by the city hall, mid-way along the zelkova mall.

properties.name: Aji Tasuke (gyūtan)
properties.cost: ~¥1,500–2,000 (tongue set w/ tail soup + barley rice)
properties.access: Kokubunchō, central Sendai; ~10 min from Sendai Stn
properties.booking: Walk-in; small & queues — go early or split into 2 tables
properties.notes: Originator of Sendai gyūtan. For a 7-friendly sit-down, Rikyū (利久, many branches incl. the station) is the easy alternative; Date no Gyūtan also solid. Pinned to 本店 at 一番町4-4-13.

properties.name: Zunda Saryō (zunda shake)
properties.access: Sendai Stn 3F, "Zunda Kōji"
properties.notes: Sweet edamame-paste shake + zunda mochi — the signature Sendai flavor. Fast group snack in the station. Pinned to the Sendai Station branch; an unbounded search lands on the airport branch in Natori.

properties.name: Sendai Asaichi (morning market)
properties.access: ~3 min west of Sendai Stn (Chūō 4-chōme)
properties.notes: "Sendai's kitchen" — covered lane of ~70 stalls; seafood, standing bars, kaisen-don, fresh crab.

properties.name: Iroha Yokochō
properties.access: Kokubunchō, off the Chūō-dōri arcade
properties.booking: Counters tiny — spread across a few or reserve a larger izakaya
properties.notes: Retro post-war izakaya alley for the group night out. Bunyoko (文化横丁) alley right next door.

properties.name: Abe Kamaboko (sasa-kamaboko)
properties.access: Chūō-dōri arcade, central Sendai
properties.notes: Bamboo-leaf fish cake; grab the famous hyōtan-age (kamaboko "corndog") off the street counter. Pinned to 本店 (中央2-3-18); there are branches in Miyagino, Izumi and Matsushima.

properties.name: Spa Metsä Sendai / Ryūsenji-no-Yu
properties.name_ja: スパメッツァ仙台 竜泉寺の湯
properties.access: ~4.5 km from central Sendai, easy by van
properties.notes: Best pure super sentō on the trip — standout sauna with aufguss/löyly shows. Fits Feb 2–3.

properties.name: Round1 Stadium Sendai-Izumi
properties.name_ja: ラウンドワンスタジアム 仙台泉店
properties.access: Sendai-Izumi Inter City (1F/2F); free shuttle from Izumi-Chūō Stn
properties.notes: Opened Dec 2025 — Miyagi's first Spo-Cha. Go here, NOT the Nigatake branch (no Spo-Cha). Fits Feb 2–3. Official address is 仙台市泉区大沢2-12-4, but the site sits on the Sendai/Tomiya boundary and OpenStreetMap tags it 富谷市 — city here follows the operator's registered address.

properties.name: Sendai Daikannon
properties.access: Izumi-ku, NW Sendai; ~20 min by van
properties.notes: ~100 m white Kannon statue with an elevator up inside — gloriously strange, visible across the city.

properties.name: Sendai Umino-Mori Aquarium
properties.access: Miyagino-ku, near the port; ~15 min by van
properties.booking: Walk-in; buy tickets online to skip queue
properties.notes: Big modern aquarium — solid all-weather group stop.

properties.name: Ichibanchō / Sunmall arcades
properties.name_ja: 一番町・サンモール一番町
properties.access: Central Sendai, between Aoba-dōri and Hirose-dōri
properties.notes: One of Japan's longest covered arcade networks — all-weather browsing, gachapon, food. Area pin on the Ichibanchō arcade.

properties.name: Ōuchi-juku
properties.access: Deep S of the Ban-etsu line on snow-sensitive mountain roads
properties.notes: Thatched-roof Edo post town buried in snow; signature negi-soba (leek-as-chopstick). Most atmospheric stop on the leg but far south — do this OR the Ashinomaki cluster.

properties.name: Shiogama sushi & Shiogama Shrine
properties.access: ~20 min E of Sendai by van; pairs with Matsushima; JR to Hon-Shiogama
properties.notes: Among Japan's highest sushi-shop density per capita; dramatic Shiogama Shrine (鹽竈神社) above town. Sushi here, oysters at Matsushima. Anchor near Hon-Shiogama Station.

properties.name: Zaō Fox Village
properties.access: Off the Tōhoku Expwy at Shiroishi, ~40 min before Sendai — use the van
properties.notes: Dozens of free-roaming foxes in deep snow (peak thick-coat season). Last big "rare" hit before Sendai on Feb 2.

properties.name: Shizukuishi Winter Festa (Koiwai Farm)
properties.name_ja: 雫石冬フェスタ（小岩井農場まきば園）
properties.access: ~15 min from Morioka IC; ~30 min by van from Morioka Stn. Koiwai Farm Makibaen, 丸谷地
properties.dates: 2026 ran ~Jan 31–Feb 23; CONFIRM travel-year window. Fireworks Sat evenings only
properties.notes: Successor to the cancelled Iwate Snow Festival. Snow sculptures, illuminations, snow slides + Genghis Khan lamb eaten in kamakura snow igloos. West of Morioka — Feb 4 arrival-night option. Pinned to the Makibaen visitor entrance; the 丸谷地36-1 address point geocodes ~2.2 km south of it.

properties.name: Shōwa-shinzan Bear Ranch
properties.access: 壮瞥町昭和新山183, ~10 min car from onsen; winter 8:30–16:30, daily; free winter parking
properties.notes: 60–70 brown bears, feed them, plus 人のオリ human cage; runs even if ropeway is shut. Shares the Shōwa-shinzan car park with the ropeway (129 m) and lava dome (501 m).

properties.name: Shōwa-shinzan & Mimatsu Masao Memorial
properties.name_ja: 昭和新山・三松正夫記念館
properties.cost: Dome free to view; memorial small entry (confirm)
properties.access: 壮瞥町昭和新山, same lot as bear ranch/ropeway
properties.notes: 398 m lava dome that rose from a wheat field 1943–45; steams harder in cold; memorial tells the postmaster-recorder story. Pin is the dome summit itself (OSM records it at exactly 398 m); the 三松正夫記念館 building is 640 m SW.

properties.name: Mt Usu Ropeway
properties.access: 壮瞥町字昭和新山184-5; winter 9:00–16:00
properties.dates: FLAG — annual winter-maintenance closure ~mid-to-late Feb (Feb 16 one year, late Jan others); verify 2027 usuzan.hokkaido.jp before planning
properties.notes: 6-min ride to lake / Shōwa-shinzan / Yōtei lookout + Mt.USU terrace; summit rim trail closed Nov–Apr. Pin is the 昭和新山駅 base station; the 有珠山頂駅 is 1.3 km W.

properties.name: Lake Towada Winter Story
properties.access: 十和田湖畔休屋 (Yasumiya), 青森県十和田市奥瀬十和田湖畔; ~34 km from Towada IC
properties.dates: 2026 ran ~Jan 30–Feb 23; operates Mon + Fri–Sun (closed Tue/Wed/Thu); fireworks nightly ~19:30–20:00; Feb 5 Fri should be live — confirm 2027
properties.notes: Snow-village yatai, kamakura ice-bar, snow slides + nightly winter fireworks over the frozen lake. [SOUTH — deep], pairs with the Oirase icefall night tour. Pin = the Yasumiya lakeside hub (十和田湖観光交流センター ぷらっと); the 特設会場 is the open ground beside it.

properties.name: Daishōen (Towada barayaki)
properties.access: 十和田市稲生町16-8; ~2 min / 6-min walk from Towada Art Center. Open 10:30–22:00, closed 2nd/4th Weds
properties.notes: Self-grilled sweet-soy beef + onion, Towada's B-gourmet. 1963 yakiniku shop, seats groups, clusters with the art museum. Famous alt: 司 (tower-yaki, lunch-only, Mon-closed).

properties.name: Oirase Gorge icefalls
properties.access: Meet at Oirase Keiryūkan 奥入瀬渓流館, 十和田市奥瀬字栃久保183; departures ~9:30/13:30
properties.dates: Bus tour Dec 20–Mar 1, Fri/Sat/Sun + New Year only — Feb 5 Fri operates
properties.notes: The winter walk-in — snowshoe through the deep-snow gorge to frozen falls, or a warm guided bus tour. [SOUTH]. Pin = the Keiryūkan meeting point, ~18 km downstream of Lake Towada.

properties.name: Towada Art Center
properties.access: 十和田市西二番町10-9; 9:00–17:00 (last entry 16:30), closed Mondays
properties.dates: FLAG — took a maintenance closure Feb 2–6 in 2026; verify the 2027 Feb calendar before a Feb 5 visit
properties.notes: Standout contemporary museum — Kusama, flower-horse, Ron Mueck + outdoor art street. [SOUTH], clusters with Daishōen and the Oirase icefall loop on Feb 6.

properties.name: The Windsor Hotel Tōya
properties.name_ja: ザ・ウィンザーホテル洞爺
properties.access: 洞爺湖町清水, caldera-rim hilltop (van)
properties.notes: 2008 G8-summit hotel; day visitors for the lake-and-Pacific panorama / afternoon tea.

properties.name: Silo Observatory
properties.access: 洞爺湖町成香, Route 2 north rim; winter-open
properties.notes: Best Lake Tōya panorama — caldera, Nakajima, Yōtei; blue-hour photo stop.

properties.name: Toyako Onsen Winter Fireworks
properties.cost: Free from shore; paid seats available
properties.access: Off 本社前桟橋, 洞爺湖温泉; nightly ~20:30, ~8 min
properties.dates: 2026 ran Feb 3–12 (run being extended ~22 days); Feb 8–10 2027 should be covered — confirm 2027
properties.notes: Nightly music-synced fireworks over the lake, viewable from shore/ryokan; the reason to base here in Feb. Pin is the lakefront pier; OSM names it 駅前桟橋 rather than 本社前桟橋 — confirm the pier on the night.

properties.name: Toyako Winter Fireworks-Viewing Boat
properties.name_ja: 洞爺湖 花火鑑賞船
properties.access: Departs 本社前桟橋 ~20:35, ~40 min (洞爺湖汽船 0142-75-2137); fireworks nights only
properties.dates: Runs during the winter fireworks period
properties.notes: Watch the fireworks from the water — one-night group upgrade. Pin is the 洞爺湖汽船 cruise ticket office beside the pier.

properties.name: Toyako Illumination Tunnel
properties.name_ja: イルミネーショントンネル（にぎわい広場）
properties.access: にぎわい広場, 洞爺湖温泉; 17:00–22:00
properties.dates: Nov 1–late Apr
properties.notes: ~400,000-bulb light tunnel in the onsen centre; pairs with the fireworks walk. COORD APPROXIMATE: にぎわい広場 is not a named object in OSM (searched squares, parks and all 25 info boards on the strip) — this pin is the GSI district point for 洞爺湖温泉, which is the onsen centre. NOTE it shares that exact fallback point with the Ippei pin, so the two markers overlap on the map until a real address is supplied for either.

properties.name: Bōyōtei
properties.dates: Confirm closed day
properties.notes: Retro 老舗 yōshoku; ポークチャップ is the order; easiest proper sit-down dinner in town.

properties.name: Okadaya
properties.access: 洞爺湖温泉36, ~3 min from onsen bus terminal; ~10:00–16:00
properties.notes: 白いおしるこ (white shiruko, ōfukumame beans + milk) + 温泉どら dorayaki; Toya signature sweet.

properties.name: Wakasaimo Honpo Toyako Honten
properties.name_ja: わかさいも本舗 洞爺湖本店
properties.access: Lakefront, 洞爺湖温泉; 2F 仙堂庵 lake-view washoku
properties.notes: ~100-yr wakasaimo confection (kombu-fibre imitation imo); get freshly-fried いもてん.

properties.name: Matsumaeya
properties.access: Onsen strip, 洞爺湖温泉
properties.notes: 名物 ホタテ丼 (scallop + egg over rice); sleeper 塩ラーメン.

properties.name: Ippei
properties.access: 洞爺湖温泉 strip
properties.notes: Onsen-strip izakaya; draft beer + 豚串 pork skewers; backup group night to Bōyōtei. COORD APPROXIMATE: not in OSM (a sweep of all 33 strip restaurants found てっ平 and 一本亭 but no 一平) and no street address supplied — this pin is the GSI district point for 洞爺湖温泉. NOTE it shares that exact fallback point with the Illumination Tunnel pin, so the two markers overlap on the map until a real address is supplied for either.

properties.name: Toyako Onsen Foot & Hand Baths
properties.name_ja: 洞爺湖温泉 手湯・足湯めぐり
properties.access: Along the 洞爺湖温泉 promenade
properties.notes: Free footbaths dotted along the lakefront — warm-up between fireworks and dinner. Pin is 薬師如来の手・足湯; OSM maps 6 more 手湯 along the strip between 140.815 and 140.826.

properties.name: Lake Tōya Volcano Science Museum & Visitor Center
properties.name_ja: 洞爺湖ビジターセンター・火山科学館
properties.access: By the onsen street, 洞爺湖温泉; closed Mondays, winter 10:00–16:00
properties.dates: Feb 10 only (Mon-closed)
properties.notes: 2000-eruption wrecked truck + rail, 13-min 3-screen theatre; indoor winter substitute for the snow-closed 西山 crater walk. Museum and Visitor Center share the building (45 m apart in OSM).

properties.name: Lakeside Sculpture Path
properties.access: Lakeshore promenade off the onsen strip, 洞爺湖温泉
properties.notes: 58 open-air sculptures ringing the shore; snowy lakefront dusk/after-fireworks stroll. Pin is 「湖渡る風」 on the onsen lakefront — the path continues around the whole lake.

properties.name: Yamadera (Risshaku-ji)
properties.access: ~1 hr W of Sendai by van; JR Senzan Line to Yamadera Stn
properties.notes: Cliff-face mountain temple, 1,000 stone steps, jaw-dropping under snow (Bashō's "cicada silence" haiku site). Steps get icy — good boots. Pair with Yamagata-city food.

properties.name: Ōnuma Quasi-National Park
properties.access: 七飯町大沼, ~30–40 min by van; near Ōnuma-kōen Stn
properties.notes: Frozen-lake basin under Mt Komagatake — snowshoe, lake walking, wakasagi ice-fishing. No skiing. Basically on the Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto line. Van #2. In Nanae town, not Hakodate proper.
